name: TimeField
description: A field for a time of day, with separate hour, minute and (optional) second segments that follow the visitor's locale and 12 or 24 hour clock.

label.description: Visible label, also the accessible name.

errorMessage.description: Shown when the value is invalid. Leave out to use the built-in message.

onChange.description: Called with the time, or null when it is cleared.

hourCycle.description: Force a 12 or 24 hour clock. Leave out to follow the locale.

isDisabled.description: Prevents interaction and dims the field.

isInvalid.description: Marks the field invalid. Leave it unset to let validation decide.

isRequired.description: Marks the field required and adds an asterisk.

keyboard: Left and Right arrows (or Tab) move between hour, minute and AM/PM
Up and Down arrows change the focused segment; typing digits sets it
requirements: A labelled group of spin buttons: each segment is named (hours, minutes, AM/PM) and exposes its range
Digits typed move to the next segment on their own
Invalid state and the error message are linked to the field
The focused segment is highlighted with 3:1 contrast, not only by color
screenReader: Entering announces the label, then the first segment as "hours, spin button" with its value
Changing a segment announces the new value
The group is announced with the full time, e.g. "9:30 AM"

use_when: Opening hours, reminders, meeting times and schedules
Any time of day that is not tied to a date
avoid_when: A date and a time together: use DatePicker and TimeField side by side
A duration, such as 90 minutes: use NumberField
anti_patterns: Forcing a 24 hour clock on people who use 12 hour (leave hourCycle to the locale unless you must)
A free text field for times
